newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV to invest $591 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: CANTV to invest $591 mln in 1997.

text.p: Venezuela's national telephone company CANTV, which reported impressive year-end profits Wednesday, will invest $591 million in 1997, nearly double last year's investment, CANTV President Gustavo Roosen said.
Roosen told a news conference the investment would include the installation of 215,000 new lines.
The new lines would bring the total in Venezuela to 2.715 million, Roosen said. This is roughly equivalent to one line for every eight of Venezuela's 22 million inhabitants.
CANTV, which made its Wall Street debut last November with a $1 billion global offering, reported Wednesday year-end profits of 208 billion bolivars ($435 million).
